newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via 7-day fixed system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via 7-day fixed system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added temporary reserves to the banking system via seven-day fixed system repurchase agreements on Thursday, a Fed spokeswoman confirmed.
Fed funds were trading at 5-9/16 percent at the time of the action, above the Fed's 5-1/2 percent target for the rate.
Analysts had anticipated a temporary reserve addition, citing expected upward pressure on funds due at least partly to Friday's settlement date of the Treasury's recent quarterly refunding operation.
The three-, 10- and 30-year securities that the Treasury sold last week all settle on Friday, August 15.
